# Sk Kutubuddin (Code With Kutub)

> Sk Kutubuddin, known online as Code With Kutub, is a freelance web developer and Python programmer based in Durgapur, West Bengal, India. He builds responsive websites for restaurants, shops and small businesses, e-commerce sites, Python automation tools and an AI voice assistant. He is a third-year Computer Science & Technology diploma student at Bengal Institute of Polytechnic (2024-2027) and takes freelance projects and software internships.

Official website: https://codewithkutub.online/
Last updated: 2026-10-26

## Quick facts
- Name: Sk Kutubuddin (also written SK Kutubuddin; brand and YouTube name: Code With Kutub)
- Role: Freelance web developer, Python programmer
- Location: Durgapur, West Bengal, India (works with clients online across India)
- Education: Diploma in Computer Science & Technology, Bengal Institute of Polytechnic, Durgapur (2024-2027, currently 3rd year)
- Languages and tools: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Python, Java, C, Flask, MySQL, Git, GitHub
- Contact: codewithkutub@gmail.com | Phone / WhatsApp: +91 62968 88213
- Availability: open to freelance website projects and software internships

## Services
- Business, restaurant and cafe websites with online menu and table-reservation form
- E-commerce websites with cart, wishlist and responsive layout
- Mobile-friendly personal and portfolio websites
- Python automation scripts and AI voice assistant development
